about: Errors the Web3D X3D Schematron reports on the export suite's files where another judge disagrees. Each names the judge suspected of being wrong. A count may only shrink; a new error, or more of a listed one, fails the build (tools/schematron/schematron.py --gate).

measured_on.corpus: tests/suite/x3d_test_suite.py --export, x3d-blender-io main 47ed742 + this change, bpy 5.3.0

disagreements.template: <HAnimJoint DEF=… name=… USE=…/> with parent HAnimJoint needs containerField=…
disagreements.reason: X3D 4.0 gives HAnimJoint the default containerField 'children' (x3d.py 4.0.65.8 declares it), so a nested joint without the attribute is legal; the rule (vendor .sch lines 3811, 4353, 4797) tests for the attribute itself. x3d.py strict validation passes the file and X_ITE 16.7.1 draws the rig (fidelity gate scene set).
disagreements.other_judges: x3d.py 4.0.65.8 strict: 0 errors (the export validates every file before it is published)

disagreements.template: <HAnimJoint USE=…/> was not defined within a local <HAnimHumanoid DEF=… name=…/> and instead is illegally referring to another HAnimHumanoid node
disagreements.reason: The rule (vendor .sch line 3674) filters HAnimHumanoid[//*[@DEF=$USE][1]]: '//' inside the predicate is absolute, so it selects every humanoid of the scene and '!=' then fires whenever a scene holds two humanoids (the suite has Z14_rig and Z14_rig2). Each USE names a DEF inside its own humanoid's skeleton. Candidate upstream report, held until he says send.
disagreements.other_judges: x3d.py 4.0.65.8 strict: 0 errors (the export validates every file before it is published)

disagreements.template: <Viewpoint DEF=…/> has 4 component statements with X3D profile=…, but requires at least <component name=… level=…/> or <X3D profile=…/>
disagreements.reason: The Viewpoint | OrthoViewpoint rule (vendor .sch line 2495) reads (local-name()='OrthoViewpoint' and not(Full or Navigation >= 3)) or count(preceding OrthoViewpoint) > 0: the last clause sits outside the parentheses, so the report fires on every Viewpoint that follows the first OrthoViewpoint in document order, whatever the head declares. The file declares Navigation level 3. A two-node file with Navigation level 3 (profile Full or Immersive) gives 1 error with the OrthoViewpoint first and 0 with it second. Candidate upstream report, held until he says send. (The count rose by one with the RigidBodyPhysics component the suite now declares.)
disagreements.other_judges: x3d.py 4.0.65.8 strict: 0 errors (the export validates every file before it is published)
